methodology.purpose: Prevent Weeks 1-6 and Weeks 1-8 team styles from being attributed to an opening caller after an in-window handoff.
methodology.scope: Complete through Week 8 for the 2023 target season. This registry does not claim to enumerate changes after Week 8.
methodology.audit_protocol: Start from the August 23 all-team opening census; search every team and opening caller for a handoff, firing, or reassignment through Week 8; verify positive hits with official-club or league reporting; record the first game week called by the replacement.
methodology.rule: Exclude the entire team-window when the replacement first called plays on or before the window end.
methodology.known_later_changes: Buffalo, Pittsburgh, Carolina's reversal, and Las Vegas changes after Week 8 do not contaminate either requested window.

audit_sources.purpose: Confirms Brown's first game as caller was Week 8

changes.reason: The Panthers officially transferred play-calling from Frank Reich to Thomas Brown during their Week 7 bye, and Brown first called a regular-season game in Week 8. Weeks 1-8 is therefore not a clean opening-caller target; Weeks 1-6 remains eligible.
